bot_instructions: Do not download a zip. This pack is individual URLs.
Post items in order, one per day.
Download posts[].file_url (or cdn_url if raw fails). Upload that video natively to X and YouTube.
On X use x.text exactly. On YouTube set title, description, tags, and download thumbnail_url as the custom thumbnail.
One ask per post. Do not add a second follow line.
Do not claim these are official xAI ads.
After posting, record the live URL. Wait gap_after_hours before the next item.
